notes.title: Our new game from Door series"Door4: Ultimatum" was released on Steam.
notes.content:
Dive into the captivating world of puzzles with the new part of the Door game series. Your task is to find the correct door among many options to advance to the next level. But be careful: only by understanding the patterns and solving puzzles based on logic, creative thinking, and clues hidden in the surrounding world you can unlock the coveted passage. If you fail, you will be pushed back, and the solution will change.

[previewyoutube=JGGCqcWGnVQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Beautiful Open World

Explore a beautifully stylized open world filled with colorful and diverse locations. Each place hides its own mysteries and puzzles waiting to be unraveled. Pay attention to the details—they may lead you to additional plot twists and hidden information.

Simulation? Or Something Else?

You will find yourself in a mysterious place, and only by starting to solve puzzles and exploring the surrounding world can you piece together the story of where you are and how you got there. Discover numerous secrets, explore every corner, and immerse yourself in an engaging plot that will unfold before you as you progress.

Get ready for an exciting journey full of puzzles and unexpected discoveries!

Game Features:

Solve puzzles that contain the main mechanic: choosing the correct door.

Use clues in the environment and logic to find the answer.

Collect puzzle pieces to gain access to new areas in the open world.

Solve additional puzzles with hidden mechanics to uncover plot mysteries and access secret locations within the game world.

Puzzle answers are randomly generated each time you start, but you can save your progress through checkpoints and collected or activated items.

notes.title: We are announcing Door4:Ultimatum
notes.content:
[b]We are excited to announce the new part of the Door game franchise, titled Door4:Ultimatum.[/b]

This game will continue the storyline of Door2:Key and Door3:Insignia; however, you do not need to play the previous parts for a comfortable experience, as this part will be quite unique. You also do not need to know the mechanics from the earlier games, as this part will feature completely new gameplay discoveries, while still retaining the beloved classic puzzles with doors.

You can expect an engaging story, original riddles, and plenty of secrets and Easter eggs to find.

[previewyoutube=R_4ZPfC6bwA;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3190610/Door4Ultimatum/

notes.title: Our new roguelike game "Calculate It" has been released in Early Access
notes.content:
[h2]We've made a calculator roguelike![/h2] Yes, it's not a joke. A boring device has turned into an interesting strategy, in which each calculator you collect sets its own style of play. Can you count all the numbers and prove who's the king of calculations here?

[previewyoutube=njhVcaQM5qY;full][/previewyoutube]

Your goal is to complete the required number of levels in a single run, in which you need to use the buttons on the calculator to get a certain number. Don't think it will be that easy, you'll be met with tricks and difficulties that will make you rack your brain over the strategy.

[h2]Game Features:[/h2]
[list][*]Choose one of several calculators to complete the game. Each calculator has its own feature and set of buttons. Spend money in the store to increase the size of your calculator, so it can accommodate even more buttons.
[*]Buy some of the numerous buttons that exist in the game. Each button performs its own special action. Some buttons can literally turn the course of the game. Buttons are capable of performing a variety of operations on numbers and other buttons. Earn money by getting the required number in the least number of moves in each round.
[*]Each button has a limited number of uses. Skillfully combine buttons to progress further.
[*]Go through ascensions to unlock new buttons, calculators, and modes. There are advanced modes in the game where the game will become even more difficult and interesting.[/list]

notes.title: Our new game Cubic Enigma is out on Steam
notes.content:
[h1]Cubic Enigma is out on Steam![/h1]

Hurry up to buy while the discount is valid.
Dive into a fascinating ancient world of cube puzzles, where every step reveals a new mystery. There are 8 different zones to explore, each filled with unique puzzles that require the use of cubes to solve. The atmosphere of the game is permeated with the spirit of the ancient world with its mysterious features.

You find yourself in this mysterious world to find the answer to the main “Riddle”. As you solve increasingly difficult puzzles, you begin to realize that each solution brings you closer to solving not only the game's mystery, but also your own destiny. It is unknown what consequences may await you at the end of this exciting journey.

Are you ready to uncover all the secrets of the ancient world and find out what awaits you deep within your own soul? Cubic Enigma is waiting for you!
Key Features:

An open world with ancient buildings where you can decide which puzzles to solve first.
8 unique zones, each with its own type of puzzle.
Reflect lasers, make sequences, change the landscape, solve tricky cube puzzles that test your thinking.
You don't know a single rule of the game. You will have to figure out the rules by which this world and its mysteries operate on your own, using logic and deduction.
Beautiful graphics on Unreal Engine 5, which sets the style and atmosphere of the game.

notes.title: Our new game Syllogism is out on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Syllogism is released on Steam![/h1]

Hurry up to buy while the discount is valid.
Join an exciting journey through a variety of biomes, each with its own unique theme and environment. From lush tropical forests to mysterious ruins, amazing adventures and mysteries await you that will not leave you indifferent.

Explore an open world full of beautiful views and locations, and enjoy a relaxing atmosphere while immersing yourself in unique challenges that will challenge your imagination and logical thinking. Collect stars by solving extra-challenging riddles to fully master this amazing world and discover all its secrets.

What awaits you in the game:
-36 main and 20 additional puzzles in 6 different zones, united by the main mechanics, but at the same time unique and interesting.
-An open world where you can go anywhere and also unravel the mysteries and secrets hidden in it
-Puzzles with unusual mechanics, involving the environment, the world around you and other mysteries
-Atmospheric soundtrack that will immerse you into the world of the game
-Themed locations, from the desert and ancient buildings to Asian gardens
-Explore every corner of this world, because every little thing matters
-Enjoy beautiful stylized graphics that will surround you with a relaxing and pleasant environment.

notes.title: My new project | Simple Game | Add to your wishlist now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=2aO1hFJc918;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2368070/Simple_Game/]Wishlist now[/url][/h1]

In this game, you play the role of an experienced gamer who decides to test the strength of games. Some of these games are hidden under the guise of simple and accessible, but in fact they are full of secrets and mysteries that you need to uncover. You will outsmart them and solve puzzles to gain access to the deepest secrets. But the path to success will not be easy - the game developer will try to hinder your progress and leave you in a dead end. You need to use all your skills and knowledge to get around him and win. Move from one game to another, and use the knowledge gained to advance further. Hack game worlds, break the rules and act strange to complete these games and finally solve the last secret. What does the developer hide in his games?

You must be able to act quickly and make plans to bypass all obstacles and reach the end of the game.
The graphics in the game are bright and colorful, which helps to create the atmosphere of the game world, but this is not for long. What follows is an increasingly tense and gloomy atmosphere in many of the developer's games.

The goal of the game is to reveal all the secrets of the games and reach the end. The player must be faster and smarter than the developer in order to win and discover all the secrets.
